_comment: Size ceilings for the knowledge layer. A ceiling is `limit` + `slack`, not a target: lower it by hand freely, raise it only with `--budget-refresh` after a deliberate decision. `slack` is headroom for content the repo does not author — the machine-owned GitNexus block in AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md, which `npx gitnexus analyze` rewrites on every reindex. It is per-file only; a tier inherits its members' slack and never gets its own.

_history._comment: Every-session cost, before and after the 2026-09-19 restructure. The old model mandated reading four files (context + decisions + state + system-map) before any major work. `measured` is the actual sum at that commit; `limit` is the tier ceiling recorded at the time.
_history._decisions_archive: 2026-09-20: .agent/decisions.md sat at exactly 100% of its ceiling, so the next decision would have forced --budget-refresh — how a ceiling stops meaning anything. DEC-001..DEC-020 moved verbatim to .agent/archive/decisions-2026-07.md; the file fell to 38275 B and its limit was *lowered* to 44032 B, giving roughly two decisions of headroom before the next archive round. Mechanism: scripts/check-knowledge/README.md.
_history._index_headroom: 2026-09-20: decisions-index.md was also at exactly 100% of its ceiling (4841 B = 39 rows + the conventions above them), so the *next* decision could not add a row. Unlike decisions.md it has no release valve — the `index` check requires one row per entry, in order — so its ceiling was deliberately raised to 6400 B: about fourteen rows of room, and the conventions were shortened to stop hard-coding an ID range that grows. A raise, not a refresh: every other file keeps its headroom.
_history._decisions_archive_2026_09: 2026-09-22: the 44032 B round was spent — decisions.md was back at 42305 B (96%) after DEC-040..043, and the 09-21/09-22 fixes had no decision entries yet. DEC-029..DEC-036 moved verbatim to .agent/archive/decisions-2026-09.md; the file fell to 29516 B and its limit was lowered to 36864 B (file + ~3 KB of entries added the same day + ~2 decisions of room). Same mechanism as the 07/08 rounds: scripts/check-knowledge/README.md.

_targets._comment: Where these should land as content is trimmed further. Not enforced.

globs._comment: ADRs carry the full reasoning behind a decision and legitimately run long; this ceiling only catches a runaway document.

session_start._comment: Loaded at the start of every session, before knowing what the task is.

before_code_change._comment: Added before touching code. Replaces the old 'read four files' mandate.

session_total._comment: Union of the two tiers above. This is the real cost of a coding session.
